jobs.title: Jr. Consultant ESG
jobs.location: Kolkata metropolitan area, West Bengal, India
jobs.description: Job Description The Junior Consultant – ESG will support the delivery of environmental, social, governance, sustainability related business advisory assignments across various sectors. The role will involve assisting with ESG due diligence, environmental and social impact assessments, sustainability reporting, regulatory compliance reviews, and research on ESG standards and best practices. Key Responsibilities: Support the preparation of ESG assessments, due diligence studies, and sustainability reports. Conduct research on ESG regulations, industry standards, and emerging sustainability trends. Assist in environmental and social baseline studies, data collection, and analysis. Contribute to the development of ESG management plans, policies, and monitoring frameworks. Analyze qualitative and quantitative ESG data and prepare presentations and technical reports. Support alignment of projects with standards such as IFC Performance Standards, Equator Principles, World Bank ESS, ADB ESF and other relevant frameworks. Qualifications & Skills: Master's degree in Environmental Science, Sustainability Management, Engineering, or a related field. 0-3 years of relevant experience in ESG, sustainability, environmental management, social development, or consulting. Strong research, analytical, and report-writing skills. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Familiarity with ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting standards is desirable. Good communication skills and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams. Location: Base location Kolkata and as per project requirements, including field visits when necessary. Experience: 0-3 years.

Data & Reporting Analyst | SQL & Business Intelligence
Professional Summary
Results-driven Data and Process Analyst with 1+ years of experience at Genpact, supporting a global technology platform. Specialized in SQL data validation, KPI dashboards, reconciliation, and automated reporting. Proficient in SQL (MySQL), Advanced Excel dashboards, Power BI, and Salesforce CRM. Adept at accelerating issue resolution by 30% through root-cause analysis and maintaining audit-ready documentation. Eager to contribute analytical rigor and operational excellence to Sustainability Intelligence as a Jr. Consultant ESG.
Professional Experience
Process Associate - Genpact March 2025 - September 2026
Data Validation, Compliance Operations & Reporting
  • Designed and maintained Excel dashboards to track KPIs, case volumes, and SLA resolution rates, enabling data-driven stakeholder reporting across weekly and monthly review cycles.
  • Wrote and optimised SQL (MySQL) queries to extract, validate, and reconcile operational data across case management and compliance systems, reducing manual lookup time by ~40%.
  • Performed data validation and reconciliation of user account records, ensuring data integrity and audit readiness across internal compliance databases.
  • Collaborated cross-functionally with operations, quality, and compliance teams to resolve complex escalations 30% faster through structured root-cause analysis and data-driven triage protocols.
  • Prepared and maintained audit-ready documentation, process logs, and escalation reports aligned with internal quality assurance and regulatory compliance standards.
  • Managed account-level support and identity-verification escalations for a large-scale global social media platform, applying platform compliance guidelines to high-sensitivity cases.
Technical Skills & Competencies
Data & Analytics: SQL (MySQL), MS Excel (Advanced), Power BI, MS PowerPoint, MS Office Suite, KPI Reporting, MIS Reporting
CRM & Systems: Salesforce CRM, Case Management Systems, Ticketing Tools
Domain Knowledge: Data Validation, Reconciliation, Audit Documentation, Compliance Operations, KPI Reporting, Process Improvement, Data Governance (foundational), Root-Cause Analysis, SLA Management
Soft Skills: Stakeholder Communication, Cross-functional Collaboration, Analytical Thinking, Attention to Detail, Problem Solving

SOHAM CHOWDHURY
Kolkata, West Bengal | Chowdhurysoham007@gmail.com | +91-6291003368 | https://www.linkedin.com/in/soham-chowdhury

November 26, 2026

To:
Hiring Team & Talent Acquisition
Sustainability Intelligence
Kolkata, India / Remote

RE: Application for Jr. Consultant ESG Position - Soham Chowdhury

Dear Hiring Team at Sustainability Intelligence,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Jr. Consultant ESG position at Sustainability Intelligence. With hands-on operational and analytical experience at Genpact supporting enterprise technology platforms, coupled with a B.Tech in Computer Science from Lovely Professional University, I bring proven expertise in data integrity, SQL validation, and executive KPI reporting.

During my tenure as Process Associate at Genpact, I supported enterprise case management and compliance systems, driving measurable efficiencies across core workflows:
- SQL Data Validation & Reconciliation: Wrote and optimized MySQL queries across case management databases, decreasing manual data lookup time by ~40% while maintaining 100% data integrity for audit readiness.
- Executive Dashboards & KPI Reporting: Designed and maintained dynamic Excel reporting dashboards to track case volumes, turnaround times, and SLA compliance for stakeholder reviews.
- Root-Cause Triage & SLA Excellence: Partnered cross-functionally with operations and quality teams to resolve complex escalations 30% faster via structured root-cause analysis.

What distinguishes my profile for Sustainability Intelligence is the combination of technical proficiency in SQL, Excel, and Power BI with a disciplined compliance mindset. Whether handling complex reconciliations, automating daily reports, or collaborating with cross-functional partners, I take ownership of data accuracy and process reliability.

I am based in Kolkata, fully equipped for both Kolkata on-site and Remote (WFH) arrangements, and available to join immediately (immediate to 15 days notice). I welcome the opportunity to speak with you regarding how my background can support Sustainability Intelligence's operational goals.

Thank you for your time, consideration, and review of my application.

Sincerely,

Soham Chowdhury
Phone: +91-6291003368
Email: Chowdhurysoham007@gmail.com
